waivers.title: Nav links must be uppercase (CEO brand sheet: 'SHOP · STORY · CONTACT')
waivers.reason: Both reviewers voted WAIVE. Locked Ledger A1 explicitly forbids all-caps text and text-transform: uppercase on every element. The CEO brand sheet requirement for uppercase nav links directly contradicts this binding decision. After 4 failed attempts and a reverted round that worsened the defect count, further engineering effort cannot resolve a stakeholder-level conflict. The current implementation (sentence case, text-transform: none) complies with the locked ledger. Stakeholders must reconcile the brand sheet with the ledger; the codebase must not violate A1.
